look_here_first: In flower, look for a single yellow star/salver-shaped flower emerging from linear aquatic foliage. Joey's close views add a striking second cue: paired plants can show mirror-image style/anther handedness.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow salverform perianth with long tube

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers open early and may wilt by dusk

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: three equal stamens with anthers that coil after anthesis

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: few-winged seeds in an elongate capsule

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mirror-image flower handedness/enantiostyly visible in Joey comparison

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Linear thin leaves; submerged plants may be more elongate and narrow than emersed forms.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Yellow, salverform, one-flowered inflorescence; perianth tube can be long and variable with water/temperature.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Elongate capsule with relatively few winged seeds.
